ci_scope: paired bootstrap over measured repetitions and two fixed holdout seeds; not a population claim or independent reproduction
classification: Mathematical construction diagnostic and bounded engineering experiment. No relation-yield, end-to-end IC, asymptotic, exponent or rho claim. Full pipeline and normalized costs remain null.
cross_instance_reuse: PASS: changing coefficients, cancellations and degree drops independently checked
mathematical_finding: A fixed support envelope E_j represents p_j(c)=sum_{m in E_j} c_{j,m} x^m over F2. Coefficients may change. Compile a parity mask per product monomial and multiplier. At application recompute actual generator degrees, select all degree-eligible multipliers, evaluate parity, remove zero rows and compact actual output columns. Exact-support caching cannot reuse changed inputs; this different contract can.
memory_scope: Retained structure bytes use actual Rust Vec capacities, excluding allocator metadata, separately from output payload and whole-worker peak RSS. Compilation may use temporary allocations; peak RSS includes all arms and reference matrices, so it is not candidate-specific peak memory. Compilation group/row limits bound temporary growth; retained byte limit checked on the completed plan.
scope: Standalone generic Boolean matrix construction, at most 12 variables. No production solver integration, external inputs, curves, targets, scalar recovery, relation collection or rho runs.
